1	package openaicompat
2	
3	import (
4		"bytes"
5		"encoding/json"
6		"fmt"
7		"io"
8		"net/http"
9		"os"
10		"regexp"
11		"strings"
12		"sync"
13		"time"
14	
15		"github.com/openai/openai-go/option"
16	)
17	
18	// Wire-dump observability is gated by environment variables and is complementary
19	// to session events (agent.EventLLMRequest / EventLLMResponse). Session events
20	// capture the logical request/response (Messages, Tools, Content, ToolCalls).
21	// Wire dump captures the HTTP-layer data only: method, URL, status, headers,
22	// raw bodies, and SSE chunk boundaries. Do not duplicate the logical fields.
23	//
24	// Env vars:
25	//   AGENT_DEBUG_WIRE      — "1" or "true" enables the dump; default off
26	//   AGENT_DEBUG_WIRE_FILE — optional path; when set, JSONL is written to this
27	//                           file, otherwise events go to stderr as JSONL
28	//
29	// When disabled, no middleware is installed and overhead is zero.
30	
31	const (
32		envDebugWire     = "AGENT_DEBUG_WIRE"
33		envDebugWireFile = "AGENT_DEBUG_WIRE_FILE"
34	)
35	
36	// bearerTokenPattern matches "Authorization: Bearer <token>" so we can redact
37	// the token before any wire event is written.
38	var bearerTokenPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)(Bearer\s+)[^\s]+`)
39	
40	// DebugSink serializes wire-dump events to a single writer with a mutex. A
41	// single sink is shared across all providers in a process so output ordering
42	// is stable even under concurrent requests.
43	type DebugSink struct {
44		mu     sync.Mutex
45		w      io.Writer
46		closer io.Closer
47		seq    uint64
48	}
49	
50	var (
51		sinkOnce sync.Once
52		sink     *DebugSink // nil when AGENT_DEBUG_WIRE is unset
53	)
54	
55	// envBoolTrue reports whether the named env var is set to a truthy value
56	// (1, true — case-insensitive). Empty, "0", or "false" → false.
57	func envBoolTrue(name string) bool {
58		v := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(name))
59		if v == "" || v == "0" || strings.EqualFold(v, "false") {
60			return false
61		}
62		return true
63	}
64	
65	// ResolveDebugSink returns the shared sink, or nil if wire dump is disabled.
66	func ResolveDebugSink() *DebugSink {
67		sinkOnce.Do(func() {
68			v := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(envDebugWire))
69			if v == "" || v == "0" || strings.EqualFold(v, "false") {
70				return
71			}
72			if path := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv(envDebugWireFile)); path != "" {
73				// #nosec G304 G703 -- path comes from operator-set env var; intentional.
74				f, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND, 0o600)
75				if err != nil {
76					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "agent: AGENT_DEBUG_WIRE_FILE open failed: %v — falling back to stderr\n", err)
77					sink = &DebugSink{w: os.Stderr}
78					return
79				}
80				sink = &DebugSink{w: f, closer: f}
81				return
82			}
83			sink = &DebugSink{w: os.Stderr}
84		})
85		return sink
86	}
87	
88	type wireEvent struct {
89		Seq        uint64      `json:"seq"`
90		Ts         string      `json:"ts"`
91		Dir        string      `json:"dir"` // "request" | "response" | "error"
92		Method     string      `json:"method,omitempty"`
93		URL        string      `json:"url,omitempty"`
94		Status     int         `json:"status,omitempty"`
95		Headers    http.Header `json:"headers,omitempty"`
96		BodyBytes  int         `json:"body_bytes,omitempty"`
97		Body       string      `json:"body,omitempty"`
98		Truncated  bool        `json:"truncated,omitempty"`
99		LatencyMs  int64       `json:"latency_ms,omitempty"`
100		ContentTyp string      `json:"content_type,omitempty"`
101		Err        string      `json:"error,omitempty"`
102	}
103	
104	// maxBodyBytes limits how much body content a single event captures. Applies
105	// to request bodies and to non-streaming response bodies (which are read
106	// whole before being emitted).
107	const maxBodyBytes = 64 * 1024
108	
109	// envDebugWireStreamFull opts into capturing the entire SSE stream body via
110	// teeBody. Default behavior caps cumulative captured bytes at maxBodyBytes to
111	// avoid flooding stderr during long reasoning-model generations; this knob
112	// disables the cap so the full stream is available for post-mortem analysis
113	// of client-side truncation defects (see bead agent-f237e07b).
114	const envDebugWireStreamFull = "AGENT_DEBUG_WIRE_STREAM_FULL"
115	
116	func (s *DebugSink) emit(ev wireEvent) {
117		s.mu.Lock()
118		defer s.mu.Unlock()
119		s.seq++
120		ev.Seq = s.seq
121		ev.Ts = time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano)
122		enc := json.NewEncoder(s.w)
123		enc.SetEscapeHTML(false)
124		_ = enc.Encode(ev)
125	}
126	
127	// redactHeaders returns a copy of h with any Authorization Bearer token value
128	// replaced with "Bearer [REDACTED]". The original header map is not modified.
129	func redactHeaders(h http.Header) http.Header {
130		if h == nil {
131			return nil
132		}
133		out := make(http.Header, len(h))
134		for k, vs := range h {
135			cp := make([]string, len(vs))
136			for i, v := range vs {
137				cp[i] = bearerTokenPattern.ReplaceAllString(v, "${1}[REDACTED]")
138			}
139			out[k] = cp
140		}
141		return out
142	}
143	
144	// captureBody reads the body fully (up to maxBodyBytes), returns the captured
145	// bytes plus a replacement io.ReadCloser that replays the full content so the
146	// downstream reader is unaffected.
147	func captureBody(body io.ReadCloser) ([]byte, bool, io.ReadCloser, error) {
148		if body == nil {
149			return nil, false, nil, nil
150		}
151		buf, err := io.ReadAll(body)
152		_ = body.Close()
153		if err != nil {
154			return nil, false, io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(buf)), err
155		}
156		truncated := false
157		if len(buf) > maxBodyBytes {
158			truncated = true
159		}
160		return buf, truncated, io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(buf)), nil
161	}
162	
163	// teeBody wraps a streaming response body so each read is mirrored to the
164	// sink as a chunk event. A final "response" event is emitted on close with the
165	// cumulative byte count.
166	//
167	// When streamFull is false (default), cumulative captured bytes are capped at
168	// maxBodyBytes to avoid flooding stderr on long reasoning-model generations.
169	// Setting AGENT_DEBUG_WIRE_STREAM_FULL=1 disables the cap so the entire
170	// stream is captured — necessary when diagnosing client-side truncation
171	// defects (bead agent-f237e07b wire capture stopped at 186 bytes because the
172	// cap + the teeBody emitting only up to the first cap-sized prefix made
173	// post-cap frames invisible; this is the fix for step 5 of that bead).
174	type teeBody struct {
175		inner      io.ReadCloser
176		sink       *DebugSink
177		url        string
178		status     int
179		startTime  time.Time
180		total      int
181		closed     bool
182		streamFull bool
183	}
184	
185	func (t *teeBody) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
186		n, err := t.inner.Read(p)
187		if n > 0 {
188			t.total += n
189			// Capture regime:
190			//   streamFull=true  → emit every byte read, no cap.
191			//   streamFull=false → emit until cumulative total reaches
192			//                      maxBodyBytes, then drop body from events.
193			switch {
194			case t.streamFull:
195				t.sink.emit(wireEvent{
196					Dir:       "response",
197					URL:       t.url,
198					Status:    t.status,
199					Body:      string(p[:n]),
200					BodyBytes: n,
201				})
202			case t.total-n < maxBodyBytes:
203				chunk := p[:n]
204				if t.total > maxBodyBytes {
205					chunk = p[:maxBodyBytes-(t.total-n)]
206				}
207				t.sink.emit(wireEvent{
208					Dir:       "response",
209					URL:       t.url,
210					Status:    t.status,
211					Body:      string(chunk),
212					BodyBytes: n,
213				})
214			}
215		}
216		if err != nil && !t.closed {
217			t.closed = true
218			ev := wireEvent{
219				Dir:       "response",
220				URL:       t.url,
221				Status:    t.status,
222				BodyBytes: t.total,
223				LatencyMs: time.Since(t.startTime).Milliseconds(),
224			}
225			if err != io.EOF {
226				ev.Err = err.Error()
227			}
228			t.sink.emit(ev)
229		}
230		return n, err
231	}
232	
233	func (t *teeBody) Close() error {
234		err := t.inner.Close()
235		if !t.closed {
236			t.closed = true
237			t.sink.emit(wireEvent{
238				Dir:       "response",
239				URL:       t.url,
240				Status:    t.status,
241				BodyBytes: t.total,
242				LatencyMs: time.Since(t.startTime).Milliseconds(),
243			})
244		}
245		return err
246	}
247	
248	// DebugMiddleware returns an option.Middleware that logs every request and
249	// response to the shared sink. Called by New() only when the sink is non-nil.
250	func DebugMiddleware(s *DebugSink) option.Middleware {
251		return func(req *http.Request, next option.MiddlewareNext) (*http.Response, error) {
252			start := time.Now()
253	
254			var reqBody []byte
255			var reqTruncated bool
256			if req.Body != nil {
257				var err error
258				var newBody io.ReadCloser
259				reqBody, reqTruncated, newBody, err = captureBody(req.Body)
260				if err == nil {
261					req.Body = newBody
262				}
263			}
264			reqBodyStr := string(reqBody)
265			if len(reqBody) > maxBodyBytes {
266				reqBodyStr = string(reqBody[:maxBodyBytes])
267			}
268			s.emit(wireEvent{
269				Dir:       "request",
270				Method:    req.Method,
271				URL:       req.URL.String(),
272				Headers:   redactHeaders(req.Header),
273				BodyBytes: len(reqBody),
274				Body:      reqBodyStr,
275				Truncated: reqTruncated,
276			})
277	
278			resp, err := next(req)
279			if err != nil {
280				s.emit(wireEvent{
281					Dir:       "error",
282					URL:       req.URL.String(),
283					LatencyMs: time.Since(start).Milliseconds(),
284					Err:       err.Error(),
285				})
286				return resp, err
287			}
288	
289			ct := resp.Header.Get("Content-Type")
290			// Stream-shaped responses get per-chunk dump via teeBody. Everything
291			// else gets a single response event with the full body captured.
292			if strings.Contains(ct, "text/event-stream") {
293				resp.Body = &teeBody{
294					inner:      resp.Body,
295					sink:       s,
296					url:        req.URL.String(),
297					status:     resp.StatusCode,
298					startTime:  start,
299					streamFull: envBoolTrue(envDebugWireStreamFull),
300				}
301				s.emit(wireEvent{
302					Dir:        "response",
303					URL:        req.URL.String(),
304					Status:     resp.StatusCode,
305					Headers:    redactHeaders(resp.Header),
306					ContentTyp: ct,
307					LatencyMs:  time.Since(start).Milliseconds(),
308				})
309				return resp, nil
310			}
311	
312			body, truncated, newBody, rerr := captureBody(resp.Body)
313			resp.Body = newBody
314			bodyStr := string(body)
315			if len(body) > maxBodyBytes {
316				bodyStr = string(body[:maxBodyBytes])
317			}
318			ev := wireEvent{
319				Dir:        "response",
320				URL:        req.URL.String(),
321				Status:     resp.StatusCode,
322				Headers:    redactHeaders(resp.Header),
323				BodyBytes:  len(body),
324				Body:       bodyStr,
325				Truncated:  truncated,
326				LatencyMs:  time.Since(start).Milliseconds(),
327				ContentTyp: ct,
328			}
329			if rerr != nil {
330				ev.Err = rerr.Error()
331			}
332			s.emit(ev)
333			return resp, nil
334		}
335	}
